parameters.query: select s.id, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.agent_name, s.reveal_virtual, s.about, s.price_source, s.price_integration_enabled, s.handoff_target, s.handoff_stop_bot, s.handoff_assign_user, s.handoff_move_stage, s.handoff_add_note, s.kommo_subdomain, s.kommo_pipeline_id, s.kommo_human_stage_id, s.default_responsible_user_id from public.stores s where s.store_id = $1 and s.active and s.deleted_at is null
select model, storage, condition, color, battery_health, price_cents, stock from public.catalog_items where store_id = $1 and available and stock > 0 and deleted_at is null order by model

select p.content as prompt, k.content as conhecimento from (select content from public.prompt_versions where status = 'publicado' and (store_id = $1 or store_id is null) order by store_id nulls last, version desc limit 1) p, (select content from public.knowledge_versions where status = 'publicado' and (store_id = $1 or store_id is null) order by store_id nulls last, version desc limit 1) k
select role, content from public.messages where conversation_id = (select id from public.conversations where kommo_conversation_id = $1 limit 1) order by created_at desc limit 15

insert into public.messages (store_id, conversation_id, role, content, temperature, stage, action, event_id) values ($1, (select id from public.conversations where kommo_conversation_id = $2 limit 1), 'agente', $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)

insert into public.handoffs (store_id, conversation_id, reason, status, target, actions_applied) values ($1, (select id from public.conversations where kommo_conversation_id = $2 limit 1), $3, 'pendente', $4, $5::jsonb)
